messages:
sam: Kicking off v2 global flip in ~5m. Canary at 1% in eu-west. Deploybot will post updates.

deploybot: v2 rollout started -> canary 1% (eu-west). Watch: latency, 5xx, client-schema-mismatch. Operators: @ops-oncall.

jess: noted. I pushed the v2 release notes to /docs/releases/v2.md last night. Can we add a short note about streaming change?

liam: seeing a tiny uptick in streaming disconnects from mobile SDK in the canary group. Nothing in infra logs yet.

sam: thanks. liam can you paste an example error from the mobile logs?

liam: sure. snippet:
```
2026-03-20T14:22:11Z mobile-client ERROR stream closed unexpectedly: EOF during header negotiation (schema v2-token)
```

anna: hmm that looks like header case-sensitivity again. v2 added header normalization but mobile SDK might still send mixed-case. Could cause 415/aborts.

jess: release notes already mention header normalization, but not the mobile quirk. I'll add a blurb: "Mobile SDKs: please upgrade to 2.1.3 to get header normalization fix." Will push in 2m.

liam: rolling back canary for safety? We only have 1% but it's repro on real devices.

sam: vote: pause rollout and pin mobile clients for the canary buckets. If pin fails, rollback v2 to v1 for affected shards. Thoughts?

anna: +1 pause. Pinning is less disruptive if we can target tenant slices.

deploybot: Action: pause rollout -> paused at 1% (cmd: `deploybot pause --id v2-rollout --reason "mobile-stream-disconnect"`).

deploybot: Pin command available. Example:
```
deploybot pin --route api.v2.edge --match "client:mobile" --version v1
```

liam: I ran that against a staging slice, worked as expected. Can run prod once jess updates release notes and we notify partners.

jess: release notes updated and published. Added migration guidance and a note to contact support for immediate pins. Link: https://internal.docs/releases/v2.md#mobile

sam: ops-oncall, can you coordinate tenant pin for eu-west canary shards? Targeting mobile-heavy tenants first.

ops-oncall: taking it. Will run pin in waves: heavy-mobile -> medium -> light. I'll post progress.

ops-oncall: wave1 complete (5 tenants). Observed error rate drop in those tenants to baseline. :thumbsup:

liam: good signal. I'm going to instrument an additional header-normalization check in the gateway to auto-fix mixed-case headers for a short window. Hotpatch will be low-risk.

anna: agree, do it as a reversible filter so we can remove after clients upgrade.

sam: consensus: pause rollout, pin mobile client traffic where needed, hotpatch header-normalizer in gateway, notify support & partners, then resume once we see stable metrics for 30m. Recording this in the rollout playbook.

deploybot: Rollout paused, pins applied to selected tenants, and gateway filter deployed to eu-west canary nodes. Monitor: latency, 5xx, streaming-drops.

jess: I pinged the partner slack channel and support playbook. I'll draft a short email for top 10 affected accounts.

liam: monitoring graph shows streaming drops falling after pin+hotpatch. Will keep an eye for 30m.

sam: thanks all. Marking this thread resolved for now. Reopen if we see regressions. :eyes:
